content:
Megyn Kelly briefly shifted her focus away from the political sphere to tear into actor Leonardo DiCaprio on the occasion of his 52nd birthday.

On Wednesday’s installment of her radio show, the former Fox News host accused DiCaprio, whom she deemed a “disgusting slob,” of being on drugs while discussing recent paparazzi photos and footage of the Oscar winner in a chat with Dr. Drew Pinsky.

“You would think a man of 52 years old would’ve gained some wisdom during his time on this earth that would allow him to be comfortable in his own skin, to be reflective, to realize what’s important in life,” she said, while comparing DiCaprio unfavorably to fellow actor George Clooney, a married father of two.

“In all that time, Leonardo has never gotten married,” she continued. “He’s never had children ... You never hear about him spending Christmas with his parents and his siblings, never mind the children he doesn’t have or some long-term wise partner.”

Of DiCaprio’s relationship with his current girlfriend, 28-year-old model Vittoria Ceretti, Kelly noted: “Nothing says you’re an aged, decrepit 50-something like dating someone half your age.”

Watch Megyn Kelly discuss Leonardo DiCaprio below.

DiCaprio, who turned 52 on Nov. 11, celebrated his birthday in Beverly Hills, California, with a star-studded bash attended by a bevy of A-list actors, including Jonah Hill, Tobey Maguire and Al Pacino, according to People.

Later on her radio show, Kelly then segued into a withering takedown of DiCaprio’s appearance and much-scrutinized love life, even labeling him “Dick-Crap-Prio.”

“To me, it looks like he’s on drugs,” she said. “I don’t have evidence that he’s on drugs, but I’m telling you, that’s what a druggie looks like who can’t control his eating, his drinking, his lifestyle.”

Aside from a handful of paparazzi images showing numerous female guests outside the venue, details of DiCaprio’s birthday party have mostly been kept under wraps ― so it’s unclear why Kelly felt compelled to devote so much time to it on her radio show.

The conservative pundit’s celebrity segments, of course, are rarely positive ― with the exception of those who are established Republicans, like actors Roseanne Barr and Zachary Levi.

DiCaprio has yet to respond publicly to Kelly’s remarks. Regardless of Kelly’s take on his appearance, however, the actor is as busy as ever in Hollywood these days.

Earlier this year, he completed work on the screen adaptation of Peter Cameron’s 2020 mystery novel “What Happens at Night,” co-starring Jennifer Lawrence and directed by Martin Scorsese.
